scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:app && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run build:app && cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.ios:archive: npm run build:app && cap sync ios && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -allowProvisioningUpdates -archivePath "$HOME/Library/Developer/Xcode/Archives/$(date +%Y-%m-%d)/Reef Bloom $(date +%Y-%m-%d-%H.%M).xcarchive" archive
